event_scope: ticks above 0.20 rad on the maximum-p95 pitch-chain joint of each failing unique trace

exclusive_event_classes.BOTH_INDIVIDUALLY_SUFFICIENT: absolute bridge and servo components are each greater than 0.20 rad
exclusive_event_classes.BRIDGE_ONLY_SUFFICIENT: only absolute sent-minus-applied is greater than 0.20 rad
exclusive_event_classes.SERVO_ONLY_SUFFICIENT: only absolute applied-minus-actual is greater than 0.20 rad
exclusive_event_classes.COMPOUND_SUBTHRESHOLD: neither component is individually greater than 0.20 rad, but their sum is

classification_rule.family_class: strict majority event class within each family; otherwise MIXED
classification_rule.global_class: same non-MIXED strict-majority class in TAIL, RATE, and SWA; otherwise MIXED
classification_rule.compound_followup: If global class is COMPOUND_SUBTHRESHOLD and decomposition identity passes, preregister an actual-position-centered absolute sent-target guard CPU contract.
classification_rule.bridge_followup: If global class is BRIDGE_ONLY_SUFFICIENT, return to measured bridge identification/order.
classification_rule.servo_followup: If global class is SERVO_ONLY_SUFFICIENT, return to actuator/physics fit and low-level control.
classification_rule.mixed_followup: No implementation selected; localize by joint and phase without training.
